title: Show Me Your Number
originalTaskSummary: Student creates own collection, chooses own two-digit number, represents it multiple ways using drawings, words, base-ten decomposition and equations; visits at least four class collections during teacher-facilitated gallery.

teacherRubric.required: Collection and mathematical models are student-chosen and independently made, not generated for the child
Every numeral, expanded expression, word name, tens bundle and ones drawing models the same quantity
More than one mathematically valid original representation; regrouping preserves value
Original instruction to visit at least 4 collections remains in learner-facing material; teacher checks real class activity separately
Avoid copying publisher imagery without rights, use accessible first-party mathematical equivalents
